knowledge_gaps: Affine-free LayerNorm largely removes the centered residual’s magnitude when its variance exceeds epsilon. Tiny recent-versus-uniform differences can therefore produce substantial normalized signals; near retention=1, behavior depends strongly on epsilon and numerical precision. Specify epsilon, accumulation dtype, retention bounds, and tests of residual norms and retention gradients.

The centered residual has signed history weights that sum to zero before normalization. It emphasizes deviations rather than directly identifying specific interests, and can suppress repeated stable preferences. Retain the uncentered exponential variant as a primary comparator; the qualitative diagnosis does not establish that centering is preferable.

The originality score of 5 and potential score of 7 lack direct supporting evidence. Compare with historical pooling, short-term/long-term preference models, and temporal difference filters before assigning novelty. Implementation difficulty also depends on stable differentiable pooling and integration with the unavailable baseline implementation.

The experimental plan lacks an exact checkpoint schedule, tie-breaking rule, budget allocation, and configuration-dropping order. Clarify that selection uses one complete four-category configuration and a synchronized checkpoint, unless category-specific selection is explicitly preregistered. Matched randomness requires preserving sampler and dropout streams, not merely parameter initialization.

No official validation results establish improvement. With 200 users per category, one changed hit changes macro HR@10 by 0.00125. Report paired uncertainty where official per-user hits are available, all selection opportunities, and the limitations of a single training seed. Training margins and qualitative feedback cannot substitute for validation evidence.

Reproduction requires explicit control definitions, scalar parameter scope per dataset, optimizer treatment of gate and retention, padding semantics, numerical parity tolerances, and bounded diagnostic procedures. The generic metadata examples conflict with task restrictions; only histories, timestamps, titles, and descriptions may be used.
